changeSet.author: welcome-home
changeSet.comment: Whether an owner's email is theirs: until they open the link sent to it, no other email goes there. The default verifies the owners registered before; registering sets it to NULL. The link's token is kept only as its SHA-256, with its expiry, on the owner's row: a table with owner_id would need Row-Level Security, and the link is opened without an owner context.
changeSet.sql: GRANT UPDATE (email_verified_at, email_verification_hash, email_verification_expires_at) ON owner TO app_user;
